name: Boards by Jaybee, LLC
niche: charcuterie boards / grazing tables / catering (caterer, per Google category)
website_check: Google Maps listing shows an 'Add website' button (no website on file). boardsbyjaybee.com does not resolve (DNS ENOTFOUND, confirmed via WebFetch). jaybeecatering.com returned HTTP 503 (no live content under the brand). Other guessed variants (boardsbyjaybeellc.com, jaybeecharcuterie.com, boardsbyjaybee.co) could not be reached from this session (egress proxy rejected, non-allowlisted hosts) but none appeared in web search results either. WebSearch for the business name plus Westchester/Miami/charcuterie returned zero matches on Google, Instagram, Facebook or any booking platform. The Google Business Profile (53 reviews, 5.0 rating) appears to be the business's only public online presence.
hours_note: Google Maps lists 'Open 24 hours' every day, which for a home-based, appointment/event-based catering business is Google's default placeholder rather than real public operating hours (no storefront, no walk-in hours). Per the pipeline's never-invent rule, this was NOT presented on the site as literal 24/7 hours; the site instead directs visitors to call/text to book, which matches how the business actually operates per the reviews.

source_of_data.detail: node scripts/gmaps_detail.js <mapsUrl> -> name, rating 5.0, reviews 53, phone +1 786-259-5992, category 'Caterer', website:null, hours (24h placeholder), 2 photos, service mentions (charcuterie boards, charcuterie workshop, graze table, cheese letters, mini charcuterie boxes)
source_of_data.reviews: custom node script (scripts variant clicking 'See more' to expand truncated text) on the same Maps URL, 10 -> 5 unique verbatim full-text reviews, all 5 stars
source_of_data.photos: node scripts/gmaps_photocycle.js <mapsUrl> 20 -> 11 unique Google Maps photos downloaded with curl (Chrome UA), each verified with `file` as real JPEG >80KB, visually reviewed one by one with the Read tool before curation
source_of_data.website_search: WebSearch for the business name + Westchester/Miami/Instagram/Facebook/charcuterie (multiple queries, zero relevant matches); IG web_profile_info endpoint attempted for 5 handle guesses plus a known-good control handle, all returned 404 (endpoint appears blocked for this session, not evidence of handle non-existence); WebFetch/curl domain checks on boardsbyjaybee.com (does not resolve) and jaybeecatering.com (503)

reviews_verbatim.author: Dianne Hernandez
reviews_verbatim.text: My husband and I did the Valentine's Day workshop and we had so much fun! It was a very unique experience perfect for date night or a girls night. Judy was very professional and helpful on teaching us how to place our food items on our boards in an aesthetically pleasing way while also maintaining individual creativity. The best part was having our very own charcuterie boards to snack on which were very delicious to go along with the craft beer at the tank. I absolutely recommend everyone tries this experience!

reviews_verbatim.author: Joice Rosero
reviews_verbatim.text: Not sure why you haven't order a board yet. The best in miami. From personal boards to brunch graze. I went to a workshop this past weekend my husband & friend couple to learn how to master a charcuterie board ourselves. We had such a great time learning. Jaybee was an amazing chef instructor and we learned so much to host our next party.

reviews_verbatim.author: Steph C.
reviews_verbatim.text: Boards by Jaybee went above and beyond for my daughter's first birthday with a beautiful and delicious customized charcuterie cart. They were flexible, highly responsive and punctual. The cart was a big hit with all my guests (highly recommend adding on the guava jelly!). Great prices and phenomenal service! Will definitely be back.

reviews_verbatim.author: Hazel Rodriguez
reviews_verbatim.text: I am beyond satisfied with the service provided by Boards by Jaybee. I have used her services for several of my gatherings, and each time I am impressed even more by how detailed and excellent her boards are. The quality of each of the meats and cheeses is delicious! She connects with you to ensure she adds the items you like, making you feel a part of the process. I highly recommend Boards by Jaybee for all events!!!

reviews_verbatim.author: Heather Suhor
reviews_verbatim.text: Attended a charcuterie workshop with Judy. Everything was setup so beautifully. The space was warm and inviting. She communicated days before the event and after the event was over. Her workshop was very thought out and she explained everything perfectly as we were following along. Her choice of cheeses, meats and fruits were a great choice and perfect for the season. Overall, great experience by Judy. I would attend again.

gallery_curation_notes: 11 Google Maps photos downloaded and viewed individually (Read tool) before selecting. Used for the site: hero/gallery wide tile = personal brunch board with waffles/pancakes (clean black background, premium food photography); gallery squares = charcuterie bar/station with trays, heart-shaped custom board, veggie+hummus box, Father's Day custom box with Jack Daniel's bottle, personalized birthday box. 'About' section images = a fall-themed board on a home table and a long table set for a charcuterie workshop (shows the workshop side of the business). Owner portrait crops (two Google photos clearly show the same woman, addressed as 'Judy' in two separate reviews, wearing a polo embroidered with the brand's circular logo 'Boards By Jaybee / Charcuterie') were used ONLY as the small circular 'about' avatar and as the source for a tight crop of the embroidered logo mark used as the site's nav/favicon image, per the pipeline rule against using owner portraits as gallery tiles. Discarded: a photo of the grazing table on a luggage cart in what appears to be a building elevator/service corridor (busy, unrelated neon mural background, not representative); a round board on a wood table shot with distracting background clutter (donuts/cake boxes) was also left out of the final 6 gallery tiles to avoid redundancy with cleaner board shots. All used images verified as real JPEGs >80KB with `file` and resized to max 1000px wide (most were already under 1000px since Google serves them in portrait orientation).
notes: No Instagram, Facebook, booking page or email found for this business despite a deep search (WebSearch for business name + city/niche/socials, Instagram profile endpoint attempts for 5 handle guesses, domain guesses for boardsbyjaybee.com/jaybeecatering.com/etc). The Google Business Profile is the only verifiable public channel. No public address (home-based catering business), so the site uses a real product photo instead of a map embed, per the pipeline's adapted-variant rule. No public price list since catering is quoted per event; the services section uses 'ask about it' / quote-on-request copy instead of invented prices, consistent with the prestigeautocargo reference pattern. Owner's first name 'Judy' is used in the About section based on two independent reviewers addressing her by that name in verbatim Google reviews. Primary language: English (all discovered reviews and Maps content are in English; no Spanish signal found despite the bilingual Miami-Dade market, so English was kept as the default per the task's tie-breaker rule). status: staging, not deployed by this routine (no wrangler command run, per task instructions).
